scope: all 148 archived structure-only-correct training records (50 fusion failures, 98 rescues); same-label correct controls from full training cohort; no composition prefilter

comparisons.failure50_vs_all_fusion_correct: 50 failures vs all existing fusion-correct training samples

matching.required: same original label, same OOF fold, different existing sequence group, length ratio >=0.7, global aligned identical residues/max length >=0.4
matching.family: shared explicit UniProt SIMILARITY family preferred; otherwise shared predefined protein-name class proxy with no contradictory explicit family; proxy is not certified homologous family
matching.selection: fewest eligible control groups first; explicit-family support then highest identity then length ratio then sample_id; no group reused within a comparison
matching.unmatched: retain every unpaired failure and reason; no post-result relaxation
matching.charge_Cys_hydropathy: not matching gates; candidates for interpretation, not prefilters

mechanism_annotation: cached UniProt function/feature text only; membrane and target mentions are leads, not verified toxicity endpoints; full record missing or feature absent stays unknown, not no modification/no disulfide
geometry: reuse retained C-alpha spatial descriptors; additionally inspect existing ESMFold Cys SG sites. SG distance <=2.5 Angstrom is a chosen geometric proximity proxy, not an experimentally established S-S bond. Greedy nonoverlapping close pairs and sequence-arc crossings are not a certified cystine knot.
statistics: 2 comparisons x 2 original labels x 8 features; paired mean differences, 2000 bootstrap, 5000 sign flips, BH over all 32 planned tests including insufficient tests as p=1. Fewer than 8 finite pairs is insufficient. Report per-fold and 0-2 vs3-4 directions only, not blind replication. Groups not reused within comparison.
literature: link cached UniProt referenced PMIDs to existing 33-paper and representative-paper abstract caches and known methods snippets; do not borrow family-wide effects for individual chains or fragments
restrictions: controls correct only relative to original labels, not experimental safety gold standards
unmatched families and annotation missingness limit generalization
